nodes.description: Absolute path to the git-tracked description cache in the skill directory.

nodes.label: run()

nodes.label: countDescribed()
nodes.description: Reads the graph file and counts how many nodes carry a non-empty description.

nodes.description: Object holding the described-node and total-node counts used for the final sync report.

nodes.label: HERE
nodes.description: Directory of the reapply script, used to resolve the skill directory.

nodes.label: SKILL_DIR
nodes.description: Path to the graph-first skill directory that holds the canonical description cache.

nodes.description: Absolute path to the repository root, used to anchor every relative path the script touches.

nodes.label: PRIMARY_CACHE
nodes.description: Path to the git-tracked description cache that is the script primary source.

nodes.label: cache
nodes.description: In-memory map of node id to description, loaded from the cache file.

nodes.label: graph
nodes.description: Parsed contents of .graphify/graph.json, used to enumerate the current node ids.

nodes.label: hits
nodes.description: Nodes resolved to a description, either from the cache or absorbed from the graph.

nodes.label: misses
nodes.description: Nodes with no description anywhere, which still need an assistant to write one.
